description: This file implements a handler for suspend and resume commands in a secure environment, managing socket communication and threading for suspend/resume operations within the Android Open Source Project.

classes.name: SnapshotCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles suspend and resume commands, manages communication over sockets, and runs in a dedicated thread.

methods.name: WriteSuspendRequest
methods.description: Sends a suspend request message over the specified socket.

methods.name: ReadSuspendAck
methods.description: Reads and verifies a suspend acknowledgment message from the socket.

methods.name: WriteResumeRequest
methods.description: Sends a resume request message over the specified socket.

methods.name: SnapshotCommandHandler::Join
methods.description: Joins the handler thread if it is joinable.

methods.name: SnapshotCommandHandler::SnapshotCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler and starts the thread to process suspend/resume commands.

methods.name: SnapshotCommandHandler::SuspendResumeHandler
methods.description: Main handler function that processes suspend or resume commands based on launcher actions.
